title: fix(terminal): size multiline table cells by their widest line
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Terminal table sizing measures a multiline cell as if all its visible lines were one line. In `openclaw plugins list`, a source plus description can consume width needed by the Name column and unnecessarily wrap an otherwise fitting plugin name.

## User Impact

At 122 terminal columns, a plugin with a 40-character name and a 30-character source/description currently splits its name 35+5 despite enough room for the widest source line. After this change, the name stays together while the description remains on its own line. Ordinary single-line, JSON and verbose output are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

Measure natural header/cell width using the existing renderer's logical lines and their maximum visible width. Reusing its ANSI-aware line handling keeps CR/LF/CRLF, color and OSC payload boundaries consistent; `visibleWidth` and the shared ANSI parser are not changed. This is one sizing defect, not a command-specific width override.

## Evidence

Exact source: base `fa420c6eb2752a78430cef1f2e3bf15cc17d8e9e` → head `2a34ff24e0f315ce108823c4101a48dd4500e329` (the fix plus test formatting, two files). [Secretless Linux/Node26.8.2/pnpm12.5.1 proof job](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/37602535942/job/112730129437) passed; its [raw logs, timing and source/tree receipts](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/37602535942/artifacts/11473362915) include:

- Baseline with only the new regression tests: five genuine width assertion failures for LF/CR/CRLF/color/OSC links, not collection errors.
- The earlier `runPluginsListCommand` boundary fixture at width122: before, Name wraps 35+5; after, all 40 characters remain on the first line. Inventory/config inputs and terminal columns are mocked in this Vitest fixture; it is command-boundary regression evidence, not a real CLI setup. All five baseline controls and all six exact-head downstream checks pass. [Fork-only fixture](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/blob/e8a2ec624b12e23c3b759ab9efea333b12bbc018/.github/proof/table-multiline.test.ts) is not part of this PR; actual CLI evidence is supplied separately below.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/terminal-core/src/table.test.ts --reporter=verbose`: **88/88 pass**, including existing large-stack, ANSI, blank-line, width and note siblings. Cold command wall time36.35s (Vitest33.44s, predominantly transformation); the earlier boundary harness takes3.72s. The new ordinary cases themselves are submillisecond-to-millisecond assertions, not added timers or sleeps.
- Installed `oxfmt --check` and root-config `oxlint` for both changed files, `git diff --check`, final exact-head/tree and no tracked-source drift checks pass.
- Fresh full-pending-branch autoreview with Codex/high reasoning and `--mode branch --base origin/main --max-priority P3`: full table/ANSI/caller context, `findings=[]`, no priority-filtered findings, complete/scoped-clean (confidence0.90), bound to the exact head above.

### Actual CLI with a real on-disk plugin inventory

In response to the proof request, [secretless fork run37609006640](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/37609006640) passed on **both independently checked-out source revisions**: [baseline job](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/37609006640/job/112751413005) and [exact-head job](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/37609006640/job/112751413409). No Vitest, module mocks, patched stdout columns, or injected inventory. The [fork-only runner](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/blob/c53e69cef7456d4d0c99ba08e532098e59925a06/.github/proof/table-real-cli.py) writes a genuine plugin package, native manifest, and isolated config with `plugins.load.paths`, then lets production discovery derive its inventory from these files. Synthetic name/id is40 lowercase `n` characters; description is30 `d` characters; the real entry path is26 characters. This is the manifest-only listing flow, not a claim that plugin runtime or a Gateway was activated.

Actual command, through the supported wrapper in a Linux PTY whose window size is122 columns:

```text
pnpm --silent openclaw plugins list --enabled
```

Raw terminal output below uses only synthetic metadata and ephemeral runner paths. Baseline `fa420c6` (exit0, Name unnecessarily split35+5):

```text
Plugins (1/1 enabled)
┌─────────────────────────────────────┬──────────┬──────────┬──────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┬──────────┐
│ Name                                │ ID       │ Format   │ Status   │ Source                               │ Version  │
├─────────────────────────────────────┼──────────┼──────────┼──────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┼──────────┤
│ nnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn │          │ openclaw │ enabled  │ /tmp/tbl-yxegtdn6/index.js           │ 2026.9.8 │
│ nnnnn                               │          │          │          │ dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd       │          │
└─────────────────────────────────────┴──────────┴──────────┴──────────┴──────────────────────────────────────┴──────────┘
```

Exact PR head `2a34ff2` (exit0, all40 Name characters on the first line, Source and description intact):

```text
Plugins (1/1 enabled)
┌───────────────────────────────────────────┬──────────┬──────────┬──────────┬────────────────────────────────┬──────────┐
│ Name                                      │ ID       │ Format   │ Status   │ Source                         │ Version  │
├───────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────┼──────────┼──────────┼────────────────────────────────┼──────────┤
│ nnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn  │          │ openclaw │ enabled  │ /tmp/tbl-tgnb4tj7/index.js     │ 2026.9.8 │
│                                           │          │          │          │ dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd │          │
└───────────────────────────────────────────┴──────────┴──────────┴──────────┴────────────────────────────────┴──────────┘
```

Each revision completed6 actual CLI invocations: table/`--json`/`--verbose` for multiline metadata and an independently isolated empty-description control. JSON verifies one genuinely discovered enabled plugin, exact id/name/version/source/origin/config schema, and no error diagnostics. Verbose retains full metadata. The empty-description control keeps Name intact on both revisions. All commands exit0, all actual CLI cleanup records show no residual descendants, and exact SHA/tree/owner/lockfile/package hashes and tracked-source bytes remain unchanged. Baseline total87.764s, head121.295s include first-call cold builds; the affected table commands take2.202s and2.996s respectively. Full [baseline raw transcripts/receipts](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/37609006640/artifacts/11477140609) and [exact-head raw transcripts/receipts](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/37609006640/artifacts/11477415520) also retain two passing synthetic supervisor self-checks per job. Complete two-commit fork proof-tool P0–P3 autoreview is clean (findings[], no filtered findings, confidence0.87); proof tooling is not included in this product PR.

Main owner/caller blobs and open duplicates were checked before publication. No local contributor-code execution, installed-package CLI smoke or unrelated full-repository suite is claimed; upstream CI and maintainer review remain separate gates.


## Maintainer verification

Confirmed through the built CLI in a secretless Linux/Node 24.21.0 container at 122 PTY columns, using a real on-disk plugin and isolated config. Current-main baseline `961f5c0b709962bd1338edb4d71559583fbd4f2f` wraps the 40-character plugin name 36+4; this exact head keeps all 40 characters intact and sizes Source from its widest line. The single-line control renders byte-identical tables on both revisions.

The PR regression tests on current main fail in exactly five multiline-width assertions (83 pass, 5 fail; 19.44 s command wall time). Candidate table suite: 88/88 pass (17.01 s command wall time). `pnpm tsgo` passes. One real `gpt-5-mini` call with low reasoning and a 4096-token output budget returned HTTP 200 and the requested multiline text; this is a provider connectivity gate, not a substitute for the CLI proof.

No overlap with Pash/Sarah changes. Contributor credit remains with ly85206559; no additional production changes were needed.

Merge danger: two-way door; reverting restores the old width calculation without stored-state changes. Blast radius is shared terminal table layout for multiline headers and cells; ordinary single-line tables retain their existing output.
